lcc_original: 以諾在世的日子、共有三百六十五年。
notes: H1961 and WTH8799 were implicit in UNV (no Chinese character); LCC's 有 is an explicit verb for הָיָה (to be/were), so braces dropped and tags attached to 有 per rule 3. UNV's 活了 likewise rendered H1961 without a direct SN on the character itself.
H3117 (יוֹם, days) was implicit in UNV with no corresponding Chinese character; LCC explicitly has 日子 → braces dropped, attached to 日子 per rule 3.
LCC's 在世 ('in the world/alive') is a syntactic elaboration with no direct Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.

Hebrew has שָׁנָה (H8141) twice: once after חָמֵשׁ וְשִׁשִּׁים (65) and once after שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאֹות (300). UNV preserves both tags, the second as a floating bare tag between 百 and 六十. LCC has only one 年 (at the end of 三百六十五年); the intermediate H8141 has no LCC character to attach to → kept as {<WH08141>} between 百 and 六十, final H8141 attached to 年.
